newsitem.title: USA: Aetna to buy 49 pct of Brazil's Sul America.
newsitem.headline: Aetna to buy 49 pct of Brazil's Sul America.

text.p: Aetna Inc Monday said it has agreement in principle to acquire up to 49 percent of a joint venture with Sul America Seguros, Brazil's largest insurance company.
The joint venture, to be called Sul America Aetna and to be based in Sao Paulo, would provide health and life insurance as well as pension plans in Brazil.

Aetna's initial investment would be approximately $300 million, with up to an additional $90 million over time based on future performance of the venture. The transaction is expected to be in place by second quarter 1997.

Sul America Seguros would contribute its existing life and health insurance businesses to the joint venture, while Aetna would provide product and marketing expertise, particularly in the fields of health care, pensions and life insurance.
